_metadata.description: OT-P0-001 — one-call readiness snapshot across the three projections + empirical trend.

requirements.title: status returns per-projection coverage + denominator-confidence + empirical trend
requirements.description: The status command/RPC aggregates each projection's coverage (computed live from the owner's `space --projection` verb joined against the live registries) with its denominator-confidence and the latest trials trend, in a single call.

validation.notes: API: coverage joins denominator (space verb) against numerator (live registries); target api/internal/coverage.
CLI: status output shape (typed proto-JSON); target cli/domains/coverage.
E2E: status against live owner scenarios; target bas/cases/coverage.

requirements.title: coverage computed live, never stored; degrades gracefully when an owner is down
requirements.description: The numerator is never persisted; when a denominator owner or registry is unreachable, the affected projection reports 'unavailable' rather than failing the whole snapshot.

validation.notes: API: owner-down path yields per-projection unavailable, not error.
E2E: degraded-owner snapshot stays partial, not failed.
